resources.string: Use from the hotbar to restore %1$d health. Not consumed when health is full.
Equip in the hotbar. Pickaxes mine rock and ores; axes cut wood; shovels dig soil. Wood → stone → iron → steel improves speed. Tools also defend against nearby creatures and do not wear out.
Place between two containers, one above and one below. Transfers one item per second downwards. Below a machine, only finished products are extracted.
Keep in your backpack to grind wheat into flour through crafting. A powered grain mill gives three times as much flour.
Your stock of one item is full. Empty this chest before breaking it.
Drag a stack between bag, bar and storage. Tap for details; hold to split, adjust the amount, then tap outside. Breaking this block returns its contents.
Add wheat. Connect a current wheel directly or through up to 12 touching shafts. The wheel needs flowing water beside it. 1 wheat → 3 flour every 6 seconds. Machines run while you play nearby.
Power connected. Add wheat: 1 wheat → 3 flour in 6 seconds. Close this panel to resume production.
Add coal or charcoal and flour or potatoes. Every 10 seconds: 3 flour/potatoes + 1 fuel → 4 bread/baked potatoes. Close the panel to cook.
3 identical harvested crops → 1 compost in 20 seconds. Use compost on a growing crop to speed it up. Close the panel to resume.

Gather wood and stone, craft tools, then explore for wayfarer caches and new seeds. Tools speed up matching materials. Irrigation and light improve crops; harvests can become seeds, meals or compost. Equip food in the hotbar and use it to heal. Use a chest or machine to open its storage; crouch to place against it. A hopper moves one item per second from the container above into the one below. Mills need a current wheel and touching shafts. These systems do not change Assault mode.
Place and use a hearth to bind it. The talisman takes you home and back to where you left. Recharge: 20 seconds of play. A clear landing is required.
Hearth bound. Use your talisman to return here.
No destination bound, or the hearth was removed.
No safe, clear landing near the destination.
Resonance has guided you to your destination.
Local trade · 8 batches per offer, renewed every 10 minutes of play. A gathering bell also welcomes traders at your home.
Trade unavailable: depleted stock, missing items or trader too far away.
Animal fed. Two nearby adults ready to breed can have a baby.
Product collected. Feed this animal for its next production.
This animal is growing, digesting or still preparing its product.

Lure and feed cows and sheep with wheat, pigs with carrots, chickens with wheat seeds. Two fed adults nearby breed, then rest for 5 minutes. Babies mature in 10 minutes; feeding speeds growth. Milk: empty bucket; wool: shears; eggs and truffles: empty hand. Products are ready 2 minutes after feeding.
Power comes from a waterwheel through adjacent shafts (up to 12 segments). Deposit ingredients; recipes run automatically.
Stopped · connect a wheel to flowing water.
The kiln uses raw coal for each batch.
The vat ages milk into cheese and returns empty buckets.
Unable to save. The previous checkpoint is preserved.

Hamlets welcome a gardener, artisan and keeper. Use a nearby resident to trade. A crafted gathering bell welcomes this trio at your home. Workshops connect two chains: ore → dust → metal → plates and gears; wool → cloth and milk → cheese. Crushers, presses and looms require a waterwheel; kilns, vats and kitchens need no transmission. Hoppers extract finished products.
Place and use a resonance hearth, then craft a talisman to return home and resume your expedition.
Animals can be fed, bred and harvested without slaughter. Walls now block the light used for spawning. Light your indoor rooms.

Deposit wheat, carrots and wheat seeds. Feeds animals within 4 blocks for growth and production. Animals with a product in progress or ready to collect need no more food. Hoppers can supply the trough.
Choose a recipe to reserve its ingredients: a hopper underneath then extracts only that recipe’s products. Automatic mode prioritizes the first available recipe.
